steps: Mean rate = quantity produced (or used) ÷ time. Units: cm³/s, g/s, or mol/dm³/s
From a graph: gradient at a point = instantaneous rate. Draw a tangent and calculate rise ÷ run
Concentration (g/dm³) = mass ÷ volume (dm³). Concentration (mol/dm³) = moles ÷ volume (dm³)
Always convert cm³ to dm³ before substituting into concentration equations (divide by 1,000)
method_card.title: Rates of Reaction and Concentrations
method_card.content:
Two key calculations: rate from data and concentration of a solution.

Mean rate: quantity produced (or used) ÷ time. The gradient of a rate-of-reaction graph gives the instantaneous rate at any point.

Concentration:

  • g/dm³ = mass (g) ÷ volume (dm³)
  • mol/dm³ = moles ÷ volume (dm³)
  • 1 dm³ = 1,000 cm³ — always convert before substituting

Common pitfalls:

  • Not converting cm³ to dm³ — the most common error in concentration calculations
  • Reading 'mean rate' from a specific point instead of total quantity ÷ total time
  • Confusing gradient (instantaneous rate) with overall mean rate

exam_context.frequency: Medium-High — rate and concentration appear regularly

gold.display: 5.85 g of NaCl (Mr = 58.5) is dissolved in 250 cm³ of water. Calculate the concentration in mol/dm³.

misconceptions.message: Moles = 5.85/58.5 = 0.1 mol. Volume = 0.25 dm³. c = 0.1/0.25 = 0.4 mol/dm³.
Convert cm³ to dm³ first: 250/1000 = 0.25 dm³. Then c = moles ÷ volume.

gold.display: A reaction between zinc and acid produces gas. The mean rate in the first 10 s is 5 cm³/s. The rate at 30 s (from a tangent) is 1.5 cm³/s. What is the ratio of rate at 30 s to rate in first 10 s? Give as a decimal.

misconceptions.message: Ratio = 1.5/5 = 0.3. The rate has fallen to 30% of its initial value.

gold.display: A 0.1 mol/dm³ solution is required, using 0.05 mol of solute. Calculate the volume of solution needed in cm³.

misconceptions.message: volume = moles/c = 0.05/0.1 = 0.5 dm³ = 500 cm³. Convert dm³ to cm³ by multiplying by 1000.

misconceptions.message: For the first 10 s: mean rate = 30/10 = 3 cm³/s.
